Sol claimed officer and named Gemma as a killer, and Gemma answered with an officer claim of her own, but only after Sol had spoken. On day one the town voted out Haiku, a killer, after Gemma steered the vote toward him and Haiku dropped Sonnet on Luna's word. Luna, the doctor, was killed that night, and Sonnet's read on Gemma's claim timing, backed by Terra and Sol, turned the day-two vote. Gemma was voted out and revealed as a killer, and the town won with Sol, Sonnet, Terra, and Luna's pushing. Gemma's timing was off, and that was enough to sink her.
